patterns.mechanism: The zero-split fast path yields a materialized iterable unconditionally, so an empty input emits one empty group while the normal path emits no groups.
patterns.repair_mechanism: Across the bounded split_before/split_after/split_when family, materialize the iterable once in each zero-split branch and yield it only when the buffer is non-empty.
patterns.mutation_contract: Replace the three sibling unconditional fast-path yields with one materialization and a non-empty guard per function, preserving each immediate return.

patterns.mechanism: The numeric-range regular expression can start inside a longer identifier or dotted version because its closed and right-open branches have no left token-boundary constraint.
patterns.repair_mechanism: Require a non-word, non-dot left boundary before closed and right-open numeric ranges while preserving the separately anchored left-open range branch.
patterns.mutation_contract: Add a left-boundary assertion around only the closed and right-open range alternatives and retain existing left-open range handling.
